name: Mathystra Relic
summary: Among Mathystra’s overgrown ruins in northern Darkshore, ancient night elven relics still hold traces of magic. The Twilight's Hammer cult has taken an interest in them.

sections.title: Remnants of a Fallen Bastion
sections.body: Mathystra once stood on the Kalimdor coast as a city and bastion of elven civilization. Before the Great Sundering, it was a proud place. Now toppled columns and cracked stones lie half-swallowed by brush and sea mist, with restless spirits and lurking beasts among them. Relics from that age are scattered through the ruins. Ten thousand years of neglect have worn them, but traces of elven arcane craft remain, and they are dangerous in careless hands.

sections.title: A Looming Peril
sections.body: Onu, the ancient tree of lore, seeks the relics after learning that the Twilight's Hammer cult is trying to weaponize forgotten elven writings found at the Master's Glaive. The cult wants to wield ancient Kaldorei magic and hasten the return of its dark masters. Onu and Darkshore's guardians study the scattered remnants to learn the cult's intentions and keep Mathystra's fading power from serving dark ends.

faq.answer: The Mathystra Relics are fragments and artifacts from the ancient night elven city. They still bear traces of the magical craft of the elves before the Sundering, though thousands of years have passed.
The relics lie scattered among broken stones, fallen pillars, and tall grasses in the Ruins of Mathystra, in northern Darkshore.

aliases: who do i bring relics to
faq.answer: Onu, an Ancient of Lore who lives at the Grove of the Ancients in southern Darkshore, asks travelers to gather the relics for study.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer interested in them?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cult is studying ancient elven texts found at the Master's Glaive. It seeks to twist the elves' old magic and use it to summon its shadowy masters into the world.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, recovering these relics helps guard dangerous ancient magic from the Twilight's Hammer and honors a city lost to the Sundering.
As a druid, you work with ancients like Onu to protect Darkshore's balance and keep forgotten magic from aiding dark summonings.
